description: Create, edit, duplicate or delete preflight profiles and their rules (flag each rule as error, warning or information, or disable it, and set its data values); load a profile from an .idpp file, export one, or embed or unembed it in the active document (Preflight panel menu > Define Profiles, Load Profile, Export Profile, Embed/Unembed Profile)

action.description: What to do with the profile

copyFrom.description: Replace the profile's rules with those of this profile (create, update), e.g. "[Basic]"

embedded.description: Act on the profile embedded in the active document rather than the application profile (update, delete, export, unembed)

filePath.description: Absolute .idpp path: the file to load (load) or write (export)

name.description: The profile name (the new name for create; not needed for load)

newName.description: New name (update renames; duplicate names the copy, default "<name> copy")

removeRules.description: Rule ids to remove from the profile (update)

rules.description: Rules to add or change (create, update); a rule not yet in the profile is added

data.description: Rule data values by name, e.g. { "ADBE_minres_cgray": 250 } (the names a profile's rules list)

flag.description: Report as error, warning or information, or disable the rule

id.description: Rule id, e.g. ADBE_MissingFonts, ADBE_ImageResolution (get_preflight_info lists them)

name: manage_preflight_profile
title: Manage Preflight Profile
